messages.author: 1c60618132b64e1a
messages.subject: opts(keep = 'legend_box') ignored on OS X?
parts:
Hi

I have today noticed a strange behaviour of opts(keep = 'lenged_box'')
on OS X. The script below produces a plot with both the actual plot
and the legend. I have previously been able to get only the legend
by using the opts(keep = 'legend_box') command.
I tried this on a windows installation where it produces only the
legend as expected.

Is this a know bug on OS X or am I just doing something wrong?

#Code:
require(ggplot2)
p <- qplot(data = mtcars, mpg, hp, geom = "point", colour = cyl)
p + opts(keep = "legend_box")

Thanks for your reply.

You are right, that it is different versions of the package installed
on my pc (0.8.9) and on the mac (0.9.0). On CRAN the package version
is listed as 0.8.9, but I have simply installed the binaries long time
ago and after that done regular update.packages(). So I'm a bit
confused about why/how I ended up with the 0.9.0 on the mac.

Do you know if keep="legend_box" has been replaced by something
similar or any workaround to achieve the same thing?

-Lars

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: opts(keep = 'legend_box') ignored on OS X?
parts:
I think this is what happened: A few weeks ago, 0.9.0 was submitted to CRAN. For a short period of time, it was available for some platforms but not all -- it turned out that the new version broke some other packages, so the CRAN maintainers rolled it back to 0.8.9. You must have installed it during this time.

-Winston
